gaps.sentence: I was made ___ the dustbin lorry at six in the morning.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, make takes the to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: They managed ___ the deadline despite the strike.
It's no use ___ about the weather.
gaps.explanation: it's no use + -ing: no use complaining.

gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ about the delay — nothing will change.
Instead of ___ , why don't you ask for help?
On the way to Rome we stopped ___ some photos.
gaps.hint: stop in order to do sth
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do; stop doing = finish doing. Here they paused to take photos.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.
